content.short: DappBack lets community members earn rewards for backing their communities.
content.description: Web3 reframes how communities participate, shifting from members being the product to players who help steer and grow the ecosystem. DappBack recognizes this shift and rewards active participation with meaningful incentives. Payouts are tied to engagement—whether through consistent activeness in the community or by using the community's own decentralized application. Members can earn NFTs as well as ETH for their engagement. This approach aligns rewards with real participation and contribution, not merely presence.
content.meta: DappBack is a DeFi tooling platform. Discover DappBack and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
